name: Serena's Head
summary: At the Dry Hills in the northern Barrens, Serena Bloodfeather's head is sought as proof of her death. Darsok Swiftdagger plans to display it on a Horde supply wagon as a warning against further harpy raids.

sections.title: A Warning on the Road
sections.body: Serena Bloodfeather led the Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills in attacks on trade through the northern Barrens. Her assaults on Horde supply lines grew vicious because her sister had fallen to the beastmaster Rexxar. Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc rogue, ordered Serena hunted to break the flock's morale. He wants her severed head mounted on an outbound caravan, where harpies watching from the crags will see the warning.

faq.q: Why does Darsok Swiftdagger want Serena's head?
aliases: what does darsok do with the head
faq.answer: Darsok wants proof that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and plans to mount her head on a Horde supply caravan. He hopes the display will frighten the surviving Witchwing harpies away from travelers.

faq.q: Why was Serena Bloodfeather attacking Horde caravans?
faq.answer: Serena Bloodfeather attacked Horde caravans to avenge her sister, whom the half-ogre champion Rexxar had slain. She struck Horde supply lines and wayfarers across the Barrens.

faq.q: Where does this trophy come from?
faq.answer: The trophy is taken from Serena Bloodfeather, the matriarch who roosts among the Dry Hills crags in the far northwestern Barrens.

angles.text: Horde caravans connect Durotar to Mulgore and the distant outposts. Displaying Serena's head on a supply wagon declares Horde dominance over the wild wastes.
Darsok Swiftdagger values clean, ruthless work. He praises mercenaries who slip behind enemy perches and execute a target without flinching.
